textos.<b>Para probar el equipo real.</b> Compr: To test the real device. Checks what the app assumes about the NanoVNA and generates a text report you can paste into an issue. Do it with the device in front of you: you do not need to touch anything, but nothing should be connected to the measurement port while it runs.
textos.1. Calibra el NanoVNA (OSL) en el conect: 1. Calibrate the NanoVNA (OSL) at the coupon connector and measure S11 of ONE stub at a time. 2. Measure the stub without a sample. 3. For a plastic: put a flat strip of known thickness with no gaps (M3 nylon screws through its four holes center and hold it) and measure again. A normal NanoVNA reaches 900 MHz (mode 1: 450, 645 and 870 MHz); the 1.5 or 2.7 GHz ones also measure the harmonics.

textos.ROE {0} en toda la banda: no entra casi: SWR {0} across the whole band: almost no power gets in. An open circuit or a loose cable looks the same, so first check that the antenna is connected. If it is, it does not resonate in this band.
textos.ROE 1 es la adaptación perfecta. Se da p: SWR 1 is perfect matching. An antenna with SWR 2 or less is considered good: at SWR 2 only 11 % of the power is reflected, which you will hardly notice in range. The lower the curve goes, the better.
textos.Se calibra el equipo con tres patrones (: The device is calibrated with three standards (OPEN, SHORT and LOAD) at the end of the cable, where the antenna will go. You can do it in one or several frequency sections: each section is saved when finished, so you can stop and continue another day. Always use the same cable and adapters for all sections.

textos.Segmentos orientativos de los planes de: Indicative segments of the IARU R1 (Europe) and ARRL (USA) band plans; check your country's plan and your license privileges. The FT8, FT4 and WSPR frequencies are the WSJT-X dial frequencies (the signal occupies about 3 kHz above).

textos.Si mides a través de un cable sin calibr: If you measure through a cable that is not calibrated at its far end, the SWR at the station looks better than at the antenna because the cable absorbs part of what is reflected. Enter the cable here and the program will move the measurement to the antenna. It applies to new measurements, and to the saved data (.s1p) too.
textos.Si no aparece en ningún sitio, comprueba: If it does not appear anywhere, check the cable connection and the calibration.
textos.Si todo el desplazamiento fuera del sust: If the whole shift came from the substrate, its real εr would be ≈ {0} (indicative: the surroundings, the connector and copper tolerance also shift it).
textos.Si tu kit no es ideal (capacidad del OPE: If your kit is not ideal (OPEN capacitance, SHORT inductance, connector delay), enter its values here: new calibrations will account for them, which improves accuracy above ~1 GHz. With everything at zero (and a 50 Ω load) ideal standards are used.
